name: MosaicDissolveSlides
job: Move between slides by flipping a grid of small tiles from one image to the next in a ripple that starts where the visitor clicked
visitor_action: click arrows or the image; swipe on touch; a quiet pause control stops auto-advance
motion: tiles collapse and turn in a radial wave from the click point over ink, flat and crisp; the photo is continuous at rest (reduced-motion: instant crossfade, no auto-advance until played)
art_direction: Modern digital: ink #0c0d0f, paper #ecebe6, one signal #c8ff3a (progress/focus only); Space Grotesk 500 with one oversized counter; seamless zero-gap tiles over a continuous photo, no frame, segmented progress under the photo
